130    The Maudsley® Prescribing Guidelines in Psychiatry
CHAPTER  1
	64.	 Tek C, et al. A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled pilot study of naltrexone to counteract antipsychotic-associated weight gain: 
proof of concept. J Clin Psychopharmacol 2014; 34:608–612.

Scand 2016; 134:385–398.

40:85–92.
